name: ssh-cluster-default-output-stderr
title: ssh_cluster: surface sub-host stderr in default output
description: When a sub-host fails in ssh_cluster broadcast, the default (non --json) output only shows the [FAIL] line and failure_class but swallows the sub-host stderr. Users have to re-run with --json to see the actual reason. Print first line of sub-host stderr (truncated ~200 chars) beneath the [FAIL] row. Reference Finding #1 in validation-report.md of parent task.
creator: jason
